privacy_sec1_p: Livo is a sports prediction and casino gaming platform. By using our website or app, you agree to this Privacy Policy. We take the protection of your personal data seriously and collect and use it only to provide our services, ensure security, and meet legal obligations.
privacy_sec2_p: When you create an account, we collect your name, email, phone number, date of birth, and identity documents (for KYC verification). We also store transaction history, deposit/withdraw records, betting activity, device information, IP address, and login activity, which are necessary for fraud prevention and account security.
privacy_sec3_p: Collected data is used for account verification, transaction processing, customer support, fraud and anti-money-laundering prevention, responsible gaming enforcement, and compliance with applicable law. Marketing communications are sent only with your consent, and you may opt out at any time.
privacy_sec4_p: Your data is stored using industry-standard security measures, including encryption. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties except payment gateways, KYC verification providers, and legal authorities where required. Data may be disclosed to authorities where legally mandated.
privacy_sec5_p: You can view and update your information anytime from your profile. To request account closure or data deletion, contact our support team — though certain data may need to be retained for a required period to meet legal and accounting obligations. This policy may be updated periodically, and we will notify you of material changes.
terms_sec1_p: You must be at least 18 years old and legally permitted to participate in online gaming/betting under the laws of your jurisdiction to use this platform. Providing false information when creating an account is strictly prohibited and may result in permanent account termination.
terms_sec2_p: Each user may hold only one account. You are solely responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential. The account holder is responsible for all activity on their account. Report any suspicious activity to support immediately.
terms_sec3_p: All deposits and withdrawals are processed through our designated payment methods. Withdrawals may require completion of turnover requirements and KYC verification before approval. We reserve the right to hold funds or suspend accounts in cases of fraudulent transactions or bonus abuse.
terms_sec4_p: All predictions and casino games are subject to their own rules (see the Rules page for details). We reserve the right to void or correct bets placed due to technical errors, incorrect odds, or data sync issues. Abandoned or postponed matches will be settled according to applicable rules.
terms_sec5_p: We encourage responsible gaming. Users can set deposit limits, bet limits, or self-exclusion from their profile settings. If you feel your gaming is becoming uncontrollable, please contact our support team or use self-exclusion.
terms_sec6_p: We reserve the right to amend these Terms at any time to reflect platform needs or changes in applicable law. Material changes will be announced on the website. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
rules_sec1_p: Once confirmed, a bet cannot be cancelled or changed. Bets are settled at the odds shown at the time of confirmation, though we reserve the right to void or correct bets placed due to clear technical errors or incorrect odds. Accounts showing suspicious patterns, such as opposing bets placed on the same event, may be reviewed.
rules_sec2_p: Bets are settled based on official results or scores. If a match is abandoned, postponed, or cancelled, related bets are generally voided (stake returned) unless a market has a specific rule stated otherwise. In case of a results dispute, the platform's decision is final.
rules_sec3_p: Each casino game (slots, live casino, card games) has its own RTP and paytable, viewable within the game before play begins. The game provider's server-side result is considered final. If a connection drops mid-round, the round outcome is settled according to the provider's recorded result.
rules_sec4_p: Every bonus carries a specific turnover requirement that must be met before withdrawal. Claiming the same bonus across multiple accounts, or placing minimal-risk bets to abuse a bonus (e.g., covering both red and black in roulette), is strictly prohibited and may result in bonus forfeiture or account suspension.
